households.csv.summary: One row per household: household head, ward, number of members, monthly income, savings and debts (rupees), vulnerability score (1 = least, 10 = most vulnerable) and location (lat/lon). Months of income owed = debts / monthly income. Possible poverty trap = owes more than 12 months of income AND savings below one month of income. Blank money values are unknown, not zero. Below poverty line = monthly income / members under Rs 7,500 (per member per month).

validations.message: monthly income is not a number
vulnerability score is not a number
vulnerability score is not between 1 and 10
monthly income is negative or above Rs 10 lakh

row_checks.sql: t.household_head IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM {{tab:households.csv}} r WHERE lower(r.household_head) = lower(t.household_head) AND lower(coalesce(r.ward, '')) = lower(coalesce(t.ward, ''))) > 1
row_checks.message: same household head appears more than once in this ward
row_checks.why: Check whether this household was entered twice; if so, remove one copy.

row_checks.value: CAST(t.lat AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(t.lon AS VARCHAR)
row_checks.message: location is 0, 0 (a placeholder, not a real place)
row_checks.why: Fill in the household's real location, or leave it blank.

row_checks.sql: t.debts_inr > 12 * t.monthly_income_inr AND t.savings_inr < t.monthly_income_inr AND t.vulnerability_score_1to10 BETWEEN 1 AND 3
row_checks.message: possible poverty trap (owes more than 12 months of income, savings under 1 month) but score is 1-3: score may be too low
row_checks.why: Review: not an error, but the score doesn't match the money numbers.

measures.label: Income per member (Rs/month)
measures.sql: sum(monthly_income_inr) / NULLIF(sum(members) FILTER (WHERE monthly_income_inr IS NOT NULL), 0)

measures.label: Households owing more than 12 months of income
Households possibly in a poverty trap
measures.sql: count(*) FILTER (WHERE debts_inr > 12 * monthly_income_inr AND savings_inr < monthly_income_inr)

measures.label: Households below poverty line (income under Rs 7,500 per member per month)
measures.sql: count(*) FILTER (WHERE members > 0 AND monthly_income_inr / members < 7500)

group_by.label: Possible poverty trap
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN debts_inr IS NULL OR savings_inr IS NULL OR monthly_income_inr IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN debts_inr > 12 * monthly_income_inr AND savings_inr < monthly_income_inr THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

group_by.label: Months of income owed
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN debts_inr IS NULL OR monthly_income_inr IS NULL OR monthly_income_inr = 0 THEN NULL WHEN debts_inr <= 3 * monthly_income_inr THEN '0-3 months' WHEN debts_inr <= 6 * monthly_income_inr THEN '3-6 months' WHEN debts_inr <= 12 * monthly_income_inr THEN '6-12 months' ELSE 'Over 12 months' END

group_by.label: Below poverty line (under Rs 7,500 per member per month)
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN monthly_income_inr IS NULL OR members IS NULL OR members <= 0 THEN NULL WHEN monthly_income_inr / members < 7500 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

questions.ask: which households are possibly in a poverty trap
questions.sql: SELECT _row AS sheet_row, household_head, ward, monthly_income_inr, savings_inr, debts_inr, round(debts_inr / monthly_income_inr, 1) AS months_owed, vulnerability_score_1to10 FROM {{table}} WHERE debts_inr > 12 * monthly_income_inr AND savings_inr < monthly_income_inr ORDER BY debts_inr / monthly_income_inr DESC
